title: 第二十三章 展销会第二十二章 五万块
lines: 陈志远的电话打来的时候，沈南枝正在仓库里打包。
“沈老板，京海市要搞一个珠宝饰品展销会，下个月中旬，在市展览馆。周总说你应该参加。”
沈南枝把手里的胶带放下。“什么规模？”
“全省的，有一百多个展位，周边几个省也会有商家过来。周总帮你留了个位置，靠中间走廊的，人流量大。”
她没马上答应。挂了电话，去找何婉清。
何婉清正在第一百货的柜台里理货，听她说完，把手里的项链挂回去，想了想。
“这个展销会我听说过，去年办过一届，不温不火的。但今年不一样，今年有港城的商家来。”
“港城的？”
“对。省里招商引资，请了几个港城的企业来参展。周氏算一个，还有两三家做珠宝的。”何婉清看着她，“这是个机会。你在京海做得再好，也就是个本地牌子。但展销会上有外地商家，有港城来的，有媒体，有省里的领导。在那儿露个脸，比你开三家店都有用。”
沈南枝在柜台前站了一会儿，看着玻璃展柜里银花项链在灯光下亮着。展销会展台得布置，样品得重新做，宣传册得印，何婉清说至少得准备半个月。
“钱呢？”沈南枝问。
何婉清从包里拿出一张纸，递给她。上面列着展位费、装修费、样品费、宣传费，每一项都标了数字，最底下用红笔写了一个总数。
三千。
沈南枝看着那个数字，没吭声。加上之前去港城参展的一万二缺口，一共一万五。陆沉舟的五千加上周氏的五千，还差五千。
“钱的事我来想办法。”何婉清把纸收回去，“你先想展台怎么布置，样品做什么。”
沈南枝没多说，回去干活了。
接下来一个星期，沈南枝每天只睡五个小时。白天在店里和第一百货之间两头跑，晚上在仓库的小隔间里做样品到凌晨。银花系列她重新做了三套，选了品质最好的石头，花瓣编得更薄，花心的镶嵌更细。野藤系列她也赶出了两件样品，藤蔓的走向完全不一样，一件粗犷一件纤细，放在一起像两株不同的植物。
张嫂帮她打下手，两个人坐在灯底下，一个编藤蔓一个编花，谁也不说话，就听见钳子夹银丝的细小声音。张嫂的手越来越稳了，编出来的花虽然还是不如沈南枝的精致，但已经能拿得出手了。沈南枝把她编的花用在野藤系列的藤蔓上，不镶石头，做陪衬。
何婉清每天晚上来仓库看进度，看完在本子上记东西，记完就走，不多待。
“你那个野藤，”有天晚上她站在门口，手里拿着那件粗犷款的样品翻来覆去看了好一会儿，“这个拿去展销会，识货的人会抢。不识货的会觉得是什么破烂。”
“那就卖给识货的。”沈南枝头都没抬，继续编下一朵。
展销会前十天，沈南枝去展览馆看场地。
展览馆在市中心，一栋老式的苏式建筑，门口有六根大柱子，墙上挂着红色标语，油漆有点脱落了。里面倒是宽敞，展厅大概有一千多平方，已经有人在搭展台了，电钻声和锤子声混在一起，空气里有木头屑和油漆的味道。
周氏珠宝的展位在中间走廊的右侧，位置确实好，一进门就能看到。展位面积不大，大概九个平方，但够用了。隔壁的展位空着，何婉清去问了组委会，说还没定出去。
沈南枝蹲下来看了看地面的材质，是水磨石的，灰白色的，不太平整。她从包里拿出一块绒布铺在地上试了试，绒布能遮住地面的瑕疵，但颜色太深了，整个展台会显得暗。她换了一块浅灰色的，效果好一些。
正蹲着，身后传来一阵脚步声。高跟鞋，嗒嗒嗒，很快。
“南枝，你也来了？”
白若溪站在她身后，穿着一件黑色的大衣，领口别着一枚亮闪闪的胸针。她旁边跟着一个四十多岁的男人，穿着灰色夹克，手里拿着一个公文包，鼻梁上架着金丝眼镜，看着像个干部。
沈南枝站起来，拍了拍膝盖上的灰。
白若溪看了看她手里的绒布，又看了看地上的展位编号。
“你这个位置不错。我那个在角落，偏了点。”她笑了一下，转脸对旁边的男人说，“孙科长，这就是我跟你说过的沈南枝，我们老乡，在京海做饰品做得可好了。”
孙建国。京海市工商局市场科副科长。
沈南枝看着那个男人，点了下头。孙建国也点了下头，目光在她身上扫了一下，很快就转开了，像是不太感兴趣。
“孙科长今天陪我来看看场地，”白若溪的语气很随意，好像在说一件无关紧要的事，“他正好负责这次展销会的审批工作。”
沈南枝看了孙建国一眼。他正拿着展位图在看，手指在图上点了点，跟白若溪说：“你这个位置虽然偏，但旁边是主通道，人流量不一定小。”
白若溪凑过去看图，两个人挨得很近。
沈南枝把手里的绒布卷起来，塞进包里。
“白若溪，你慢慢看。我先走了。”
“哎，南枝，”白若溪叫住她，“晚上一起吃饭吧？叫上沉舟哥。咱们老乡在京海，难得聚聚。”
沈南枝停下来，转过身，看着她。
白若溪站在展位中间，灯光照在她身上，黑色大衣衬得她皮肤很白，笑得很温柔。孙建国站在她旁边，已经把展位图收起来了，正低头看手表上的时间。
content_en:
When Chen Zhiyuan's call came, Shen Nanzhi was packing in the warehouse.
"Boss Shen, Jinghai City is holding a jewelry fair in the middle of next month at the city exhibition hall. Mr. Zhou said you should attend."
Shen Nanzhi put down the tape in his hand. "What scale?"
"There are more than a hundred booths across the province, and businesses from several surrounding provinces will also come. Mr. Zhou has reserved a seat for you. The one near the middle corridor has a lot of traffic."
She didn't agree immediately. Hang up the phone and go find He Wanqing.
He Wanqing was tallying goods at the counter of the First Department Store. After hearing what she said, he hung up the necklace in his hand and thought about it.
"I've heard about this trade fair. It was held last year and it was tepid. But this year is different. This year there are merchants from Hong Kong City coming."
"From Hong Kong City?"
"Yes. The province is attracting investment and has invited several enterprises from the port city to participate in the exhibition. The Zhou family is one, and there are two or three companies that make jewelry." He Wanqing looked at her, "This is an opportunity. No matter how well you do in Jinghai, it is still a local brand. But at the exhibition, there are foreign merchants, people from the port city, media, and leaders from the province. Showing your face there is more useful than opening three stores."
Shen Nanzhi stood in front of the counter for a while, watching the silver flower necklace in the glass display case light up under the light. The exhibition booth had to be decorated, samples had to be redone, and brochures had to be printed. He Wanqing said it would take at least half a month to prepare.
"Where's the money?" Shen Nanzhi asked.
He Wanqing took out a piece of paper from her bag and handed it to her. It lists booth fees, decoration fees, sample fees, and publicity fees. Each item is marked with a number, and a total is written in red pen at the bottom.
Three thousand.
Shen Nanzhi looked at the number and said nothing. Including the gap of 12,000 from the previous exhibition in Hong Kong City, the total is 15,000. Lu Chenzhou's five thousand plus Zhou's five thousand was still five thousand short.
"I'll figure out how to deal with the money." He Wanqing took the paper back, "You first think about how to arrange the booth and what to do with the samples."
Shen Nanzhi didn't say much and went back to work.
For the next week, Shen Nanzhi slept only five hours a day. During the day, I traveled between the store and the No. 1 Department Store, and at night, I worked in a small cubicle in the warehouse making samples until the early hours of the morning. She made three new sets of the Silver Flower series, choosing the best quality stones, braiding the petals thinner, and inlaying the flower center with finer details. She also produced two samples of the wild vine series. The vines have completely different directions. One is rough and the other is slender. Put together they look like two different plants.
Sister-in-law Zhang helped her, and the two of them sat under the lamp, one braiding vines and the other braiding flowers. No one said anything, and they could hear the small sound of pliers clamping silver wire. Mrs. Zhang's hands are becoming more and more stable. Although the flowers she weaves are still not as exquisite as Shen Nanzhi's, she can already make them. Shen Nanzhi used her braided flowers on the vines of the Wild Vine series without inlaying stones as a foil.
He Wanqing comes to the warehouse every night to check on the progress. After finishing the work, he writes things down in his notebook and then leaves without staying too long.
"That wild vine of yours," she stood at the door one night, holding the rugged model in her hand and looking over it for a long time. "If you take this to a trade fair, people who know the product will grab it. People who don't know the product will think it's junk."
"Then sell it to someone who knows the goods." Shen Nan continued to weave the next one without even raising the branch.
Ten days before the trade fair, Shen Nanzhi went to the exhibition hall to look at the venue.
The exhibition hall is in the city center, an old Soviet-style building with six large pillars at the door, red slogans hanging on the wall, and the paint is peeling off. It's quite spacious inside. The exhibition hall is about more than a thousand square meters. Someone is already setting up a booth. The sound of electric drills and hammers are mixed together, and the air smells of wood chips and paint.
The Zhou Jewelry booth is on the right side of the middle corridor. The location is really good and you can see it as soon as you enter the door. The booth area is not large, about nine square meters, but it is enough. The booth next door was empty, so He Wanqing went to ask the organizing committee and said that they had not decided to go out yet.
Shen Nanzhi knelt down and looked at the material of the ground. It was made of terrazzo, gray-white, and not very smooth. She took out a piece of flannel cloth from her bag and spread it on the ground to try it out. The flannel cloth could cover the imperfections on the ground, but the color was too dark and the entire booth would look dark. She replaced it with a light gray one, which worked better.
As he was squatting, there was a sound of footsteps behind him. High heels, click, click, fast.
"Nanzhi, are you here too?"
Bai Ruoxi stood behind her, wearing a black coat with a shiny brooch on the collar. Next to her was a man in his forties, wearing a gray jacket, holding a briefcase in his hand, and wearing gold-rimmed glasses on the bridge of his nose. He looked like a cadre.
Shen Nanzhi stood up and patted the ashes on his knees.
"Yeah."
Bai Ruoxi looked at the flannel in her hand, and then at the booth number on the ground.
"You're in a good position. Mine is in the corner, a little off." She smiled, turned to the man next to her and said, "Section Chief Sun, this is the Shen Nanzhi I told you about. Our fellow villagers are doing a great job in making jewelry in Jinghai."
Sun Jianguo. Deputy Section Chief of the Marketing Section of Jinghai Industrial and Commercial Bureau.
Shen Nanzhi looked at the man and nodded. Sun Jianguo also nodded, glanced at her, and then quickly looked away, as if he wasn't too interested.
"Section Chief Sun came with me to check out the venue today," Bai Ruoxi's tone was casual, as if she was talking about an insignificant matter, "He happens to be in charge of the approval work for this exhibition."
Shen Nanzhi glanced at Sun Jianguo. He was looking at the booth map, tapping his finger on the map, and said to Bai Ruoxi: "Although your location is far away, it is next to the main channel, so the flow of people is not necessarily small."
Bai Ruoxi leaned over to look at the picture. The two of them were very close to each other.
Shen Nanzhi rolled up the flannel in his hand and stuffed it into his bag.
"Bai Ruoxi, take your time and watch. I'm leaving first."
"Hey, Nanzhi," Bai Ruoxi stopped her, "Shall we have dinner together tonight? Call Brother Shen Zhou. We fellows are here
